{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-6","id":"msg_01CVkGS7WdqaMSz9zNCCxP6T","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Qr1iB3oVuC61sj89MaeNgv","name":"mcp__agent-ml-research__ssh_execute","input":{"server":"westd-17855","command":"source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 -c \"\nimport json, base64, hashlib, os\n\nwith open('/root/autodl-tmp/distrib_canary_collapse/results/analysis/conditional_granger_v2.json', 'rb') as f:\n    raw = f.read()\n\n# Compute hash for verification\nmd5 = hashlib.md5(raw).hexdigest()\nprint(f'FILE_SIZE:{len(raw)}')\nprint(f'FILE_MD5:{md5}')\n\n# Encode to base64\nb64 = base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')\n\n# Split into chunks of 4000 chars (safely under SSH truncation)\nchunk_size = 4000\nn_chunks = (len(b64) + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size\nprint(f'N_CHUNKS:{n_chunks}')\nprint(f'B64_LEN:{len(b64)}')\n\n# Write chunks to files\nos.makedirs('/tmp/cg_xfer', exist_ok=True)\nfor i in range(n_chunks):\n    chunk = b64[i*chunk_size:(i+1)*chunk_size]\n    with open(f'/tmp/cg_xfer/chunk_{i:03d}', 'w') as f:\n        f.write(chunk)\nprint('CHUNKS_WRITTEN')\n\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2346,"cache_read_input_tokens":138611,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2346,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_0198H2gvfFwgLMuJwqZwKZAL","session_id":"3a3574ba-3b45-489f-b006-cf1e8aa906cb","uuid":"d3087787-0015-4699-8a1d-481172eeadac"}
